name: hcapp_getDownDowns
description: Returns all DownDown charges for a run (including pending, done, and cancelled), with each charge's list of named hashers. Returns two result rowsets on success. Auth: GM (MismanagementRoles bit 0x02) or RA (0x08). Intended for the run admin / RA screen. Read-only SP — no success envelope. New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to fetch DownDowns for. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Compact error envelope returned on auth, validation, or role failure: { success=0, errorCode, errorType }. Followed by StandardErrorResult at index 1. Mutually exclusive with DownDowns rowset.

rowsets.name: DownDowns
rowsets.description: One row per DownDown charge for the event, ordered by CreatedAt ASC. Empty result set when no charges exist. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope rowset.

columns.name: downDownId
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.id — primary key of the charge.

columns.name: isDone
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.IsDone — column is BIT in the table; serialised as JSON boolean by the .NET shim. 1/true = delivered.

columns.name: isCancelled
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.IsCancelled — column is BIT in the table; serialised as JSON boolean by the .NET shim. 1/true = cancelled.

columns.name: songChoice
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.SongChoice — suggested song name, or NULL if not set.

columns.name: songId
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.SongId cast to lowercase NVARCHAR(40) via LOWER(CAST(...)). NULL if not set.

columns.name: chargePhotoUrl
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.ChargePhotoUrl — blob URL of an attached charge photo, or NULL.

columns.name: createdByDisplayName
columns.description: HC.Hasher.DisplayName (persisted computed column) for the charge creator.

columns.name: createdByPhoto
columns.description: HC.Hasher.Photo for the charge creator — profile photo URL.

columns.name: createdAt
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.CreatedAt — UTC datetime when the charge was created.

rowsets.name: DownDownHashers
rowsets.description: One row per charged hasher across all DownDowns returned in rowset 0. The client groups by downDownId to associate hashers with their charge. Empty when no DownDowns exist.

columns.name: downDownId
columns.description: HC.DownDownHashers.DownDownId — FK linking back to rowset 0.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: HC.Hasher.DisplayName (persisted computed column) for the charged hasher.

rowsets.description: Returned at index 1 alongside the ErrorEnvelope (index 0) on auth, validation, or role errors. Mutually exclusive with DownDownHashers rowset.

sideEffects: Writes to HC.ErrorLog on auth, validation, or role errors.

codeSmells.issue: IsDone and IsCancelled columns are BIT, not SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: HC.DownDowns.IsDone and IsCancelled are BIT NOT NULL. The .NET shim serialises BIT as JSON boolean (true/false). Dart callers must parse these as boolean, not as int: use json['isDone'] == true || json['isDone'] == 1.
The SP sets SET NOCOUNT ON but not SET XACT_ABORT ON. Since this is a read-only SP this is harmless, but it is inconsistent with the HC6 SP standard which requires both.
